explicit_ACs: Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Name: Required. Error if empty: "Name is required".
Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Email: Required. Must be a valid email format. Error if invalid: "Invalid email number".
Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Password: Required. Masked input. Error if empty: "Password is required".
Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Confirm Password: Required. Masked input. Error if empty: "Confirm the password".
Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Create Account Button: Validates all fields and creates the account. On success, redirects to the Home Screen.
Users can register quickly using their existing Google identity: — Sign up with Google Button: Initiates the Google OAuth 2.0 flow when tapped.
There is a path for users who already have an account to prevent duplicate registrations: — Log in Link: Text "Log in" located at the bottom of the form.
If the email is already registered, display the message: "An account with this email already exists".
implicit_ACs: The sign up screen should display a prominent heading or title (e.g., 'Create Account' or 'Sign Up') at the top of the form
The sign up screen should display the Exclusive platform logo or brand name visibly, typically at the top of the screen
The sign up screen should display a short subtitle or descriptive text beneath the main heading to provide context for the registration form (e.g., 'Enter your details below')
The Name input field should have a visible label or placeholder text identifying it as the 'Name' field
The Email input field should have a visible label or placeholder text identifying it as the 'Email' field
The Password input field should have a visible label or placeholder text identifying it as the 'Password' field
The Confirm Password input field should have a visible label or placeholder text identifying it as the 'Confirm Password' field
The Password field should include a visible show/hide toggle icon to allow the user to reveal or mask the entered password
The Confirm Password field should include a visible show/hide toggle icon to allow the user to reveal or mask the entered confirmation password
A visual divider or separator (e.g., a horizontal line with 'or' label) should be displayed between the manual registration form and the Sign up with Google button
The Sign up with Google button should display the recognisable Google logo or icon alongside its label text
The bottom of the form should display accompanying static text before the 'Log in' link, such as 'Already have an account?' to provide context for the link

verified_discrepancies.description: The registration form does not include a 'Confirm Password' input field, which is required by the acceptance criteria.
verified_discrepancies.violated_criterion: Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Confirm Password: Required. Masked input. Error if empty: "Confirm the password".
verified_discrepancies.feedback: The 'Confirm Password Field' is missing from the design at form body. This element is required by AC-01 and was not found in 5 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.
